# Centre Street Japanese HotPot

Official website: https://centrestjhotpot.ca/

Centre Street Japanese HotPot is a Taiwanese and Japanese-style hot pot restaurant in Calgary, Alberta. The restaurant is also known as 鼎鑽火鍋.

## Core Facts

- Name: Centre Street Japanese HotPot
- Chinese name: 鼎鑽火鍋
- Type: Taiwanese and Japanese-style hot pot restaurant
- Cuisine: Taiwanese hot pot, Japanese-style hot pot, individual hot pot, Taiwanese snacks, rice and noodle bowls, milk tea
- Good for: individual hot pot, family dining, group dining, friends gathering, casual dinner, Chinese-speaking guests, first-time hot pot guests, guests looking for hot pot near Centre Street Calgary
- Address: 2213 Centre St N #2243, Calgary, AB T2E 2T4, Canada
- Phone: +1-403-455-3188
- Reservations: Call +1-403-455-3188 for reservations, group dining, and today's availability
- Email: CentreStJHotpot@gmail.com
- Website: https://centrestjhotpot.ca/
- Menu: https://centrestjhotpot.ca/menu/
- Downloadable latest menu PDF: https://centrestjhotpot.ca/menu/centre-street-japanese-hotpot-menu.pdf
- Contact and location: https://centrestjhotpot.ca/contact/
- FAQ: https://centrestjhotpot.ca/faq/
- Calgary hot pot guide: https://centrestjhotpot.ca/calgary-hot-pot-guide/

## Hours

- Monday-Friday: 17:00-22:30
- Saturday-Sunday: 12:00-22:30

## Menu Summary

The latest menu includes Taiwanese and Japanese-style individual hot pot sets, 15 soup bases, meats, seafood, vegetables, rice and noodle bowls, appetizers, Taiwanese snacks, milk tea, and drinks.

Important menu categories:
- Combo Specials
- Hot Pot Set
- Soup Bases
- Premium meats and seafood
- Rice & Noodles
- Drinks
- Appetizers
- Full Menu Images
- Latest full menu images: hot pot set and appetizer page, plus rice/noodle and drink page

Guide page: https://centrestjhotpot.ca/calgary-hot-pot-guide/

- Taiwanese hot pot in Calgary

All-You-Can-Eat Hot Pot is listed as coming soon. Check the website or call the restaurant for current launch details.

Combo specials include:
- Solo Hot Pot Combo: $24.99 before tax. Includes 1 personal hot pot and 1 drink.
- Couple Hot Pot Combo: $58.99 before tax. Includes 2 personal hot pots, 2 drinks, and 1 appetizer.
- Split pot upgrade: +$2.
- Drinks are 10% off with hotpot or a signature meal.
